definition: II. [ מוּשׁ ] verb feel (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic , מוּשׁ id. ; secondary form of משׁשׁ q. v.); — Qal Imperfect 1 singular suffix וַאֲֻמשְׁךָ Gen 27:21 draw near that I may feel thee. Hiph`il Imperfect 3 masculine plural וְלֹא יִמִישׁוּן יְדֵיהֶם Ps 115:7 as for their hands, they do not feel (of idols; || דַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלּ֑בוּ ); Imperative suffix וַהֲמִישֵׁנִי Judg 16:26 Qr ( Kt והימשׁני , see ימשׁ ), but read וַהֲּמִשֵּׁנִי , see משׁשׁ . מוֺשָׁב see ישׁב .

II. [מוּשׁ] verb feel (Late Hebrew id.; Aramaic , מוּשׁ id.; secondary form of משׁשׁ q. v.); —

Qal Imperfect 1 singular suffix וַאֲֻמשְׁךָ Gen 27:21 draw near that I may feel thee. Hiph`il Imperfect 3 masculine plural וְלֹא יִמִישׁוּן יְדֵיהֶם Ps 115:7 as for their hands, they do not feel (of idols; || דַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלּ֑בוּ); Imperative suffix וַהֲמִישֵׁנִי Judg 16:26 Qr (Kt והימשׁני, see ימשׁ), but read וַהֲּמִשֵּׁנִי, see משׁשׁ.

מוֺשָׁב see ישׁב.
